scenes.name: THE MIRROR
lines: Stand in front of a mirror wall, and your twin stands behind the glass.
站在一面镜墙前，镜子里就站着另一个你。
The zeta function has a mirror like that: the line where the real part is one half.
ζ 函数也有这样一面镜子：实部等于二分之一的那条线。
Its nontrivial zeros come in mirror pairs. But does a mirror make you stand on the glass?
它的非平凡零点成对出现，互为镜像。可镜子会逼你站到玻璃上吗？

scenes.name: TWO LAMPS
lines: Here is a ruler for the glass. Put one lamp at zero and one lamp at one.
先做一把量镜面的尺：在 0 放一盏灯，在 1 放一盏灯。
Take any point. Divide its distance to lamp one by its distance to lamp zero.
任取一点，用它到灯 1 的距离，除以它到灯 0 的距离。
At two, that is one over two: one half. At minus one, it is two over one: two.
在 2 处，得 1 比 2，即二分之一；在 −1 处，得 2 比 1，即 2。
Minus one is the mirror image of two. The mirror swaps the two distances, so the ratio flips.
−1 正是 2 的镜像。镜子交换两段距离，比值就倒了过来。
Only on the line halfway between the lamps is the ratio exactly one.
只有在两灯正中间的那条线上，比值才恰好是 1。

scenes.name: THE RULER IS A THEOREM
lines: The lamps are a picture. The ratio is the size of s minus one, over s.
两盏灯只是比方；比值本身，就是 s 减 1 除以 s 的模长。
Lean checks, for every complex number, that this ratio is one exactly when the real part is one half.
Lean 内核检验：对每个复数，比值等于 1，当且仅当实部是二分之一。
Lean also checks: the Riemann hypothesis means every nontrivial zero has ratio one.
Lean 还检验：黎曼猜想等价于每个非平凡零点的比值都是 1。
The mirror also halves the search: no zero with real part strictly between one half and one is enough.
镜子还把搜索减半：只要没有零点的实部严格介于 1/2 与 1 之间，就够了。

scenes.name: A PERFECT FORGERY
lines: Now a forgery. Take a polynomial with four zeros: one half, plus or minus a quarter, plus or minus fourteen i.
现在造一个赝品：一个四次多项式，四个零点是 1/2 ± 1/4 ± 14i。
It has zeta's two symmetries: the half-turn s to one minus s, and the up–down flip. Together they make the mirror.
ζ 的两种对称它都有：绕 ½ 的半圈转动 s ↦ 1 − s，和上下翻转；两者合起来，才是左右镜像。
Yet none of its zeros is on the line. Their ratios form a mirror pair.
可它没有一个零点在线上；四个零点的比值，两两成一对镜像。
Along the line itself, its values are real and never drop below forty-nine.
沿着那条线，它取实数值，而且从不低于 49。
For any nonzero shift and height, Lean checks both symmetries and that all four zeros miss the line.
对任意非零偏移与高度，Lean 检验了两种对称，以及四个零点全不在线上。

scenes.name: WHY WE BELIEVED IT
lines: Why did we think symmetry would seat the zeros? A mirror feels like a law of position. It is not.
我们凭什么以为对称会把零点安放在线上？镜子像是规定了位置，其实没有。
A mirror tells you where your twin stands, never where you stand.
镜子只告诉你镜中人站在哪，从不告诉你自己站在哪。
Any proof that the zeros sit on the line must use something beyond these two symmetries.
任何把零点钉在线上的证明，都必须动用这两种对称之外的东西。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: The Riemann hypothesis itself has an external Lean proof, replayed independently, but not frozen in this book's repository.
黎曼猜想本身已有外部的 Lean 证明，经多方独立重放，但没有冻结进本书所钉的仓库。
The lamps and the mirror are pictures, not proofs.
灯和镜子是比方，不是证明。
And this chapter's own pivot program still waits on an open problem: the arithmetic area law.
本章自己的枢轴纲领，仍卡在一个开放问题上：算术面积律。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-one.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十一章
